name: review-flight-deck
title: A reviewer surface above several pull requests
outcome: A reviewer selects several pull requests, opens one surface that shows where they overlap, conflict, and reinforce each other, and leaves with a decision recorded against each pull request: review alone, merge together, or split.
done_when: A reviewer selects more than one pull request in the viewer and sees them on one surface.
The surface names the evidence behind every relationship it claims, and says so when it cannot assess one.
Each selected pull request carries one recorded call in the append-only ledger, and that call names the set it was judged against.
A terminal-side mode reads those calls, shows the git plan, and asks before it acts.

min_work.derived_from: 3 districts touched (viewer, scripts, .cobuilder-architect). 4 colliding ADRs: ADR-0001 (one self-contained file under a blocking content policy), ADR-0018 (one lifecycle surface and a derived record index), ADR-0019 (the append-only ledger), ADR-0020 (viewer parts and an author-time build, decided and not executed).
min_work.note: Stages 0 to 4 ran. Stage 3 issued six isolated exploration frames and one separate critic pass. Stage 4 raised three challenges that the engineer has not yet answered, so challenge_stage_run stays false and no ADR is written. docs/architecture/designs/review-flight-deck/layout-variations.html holds the five layouts and the measured evidence the gate rests on.
